scope: Targeted systematic sweep of per-unit/global U1 composition and receipt-scope absence/filtering boundaries; not an exhaustive linker/ELF audit or adoption.

findings_fixed.root: Local U1 plans were committed without checking every original same-signature allocated COMDAT copy.
findings_fixed.fix: V17 check_u1_group_closure requires every original positive/zero-sized allocated affected member to belong to its own unit removal set and have one supported canonical COMDAT membership, then compares complete original copy roles/metadata/contents/targets in a remapped metadata-only view. No aggregate witness or new removal is authorized.

findings_fixed.root: A negative bounded-mode check and lossy build_summary filter treated absent scope/units as full evidence.
findings_fixed.fix: Every new prepare requires a schema-2 full build-receipt with positive whole-image/BLZ input/output hashes and equality checks, fresh PASS, coherent unit/credit/compiler provenance and complete selected U1 action/member/witness schema. Summaries identify themselves as non-receipts and retain scope; hash-bound complete receipts are revalidated at review/finalize/history.

closure_sweep.inputs: sections plus dependency_sections, original symbols/reference identity, retention roots, relocation transports and group metadata
closure_sweep.result: Original object proof and existing foreign-reference veto keep zero-sized/unplaced/retained sources visible; no prepared aggregate is allowed to supply positive U1 evidence. Inherited v11-v16 negative matrices all executed.

closure_sweep.inputs: all original local plans, positive and zero-sized allocated sections, raw group copies/indices, canonical symbol-table/signature provenance
closure_sweep.result: Kept/unplaced/zero/unproved affected members and unknown flags or unrepresented members veto; raw-reader group_issues/group_copies prevent loss before the global census. Unknown flags 0/3 and unrepresented-index regressions executed.

closure_sweep.inputs: remapped original section identities; complete code/companion bytes, mapping/symbol/section/group metadata and resolved relocation-target identities
closure_sweep.result: Existing complete destructor-copy checker is used only as a negative composition proof. Equal closed copies accepted at preparation, changed D0/extab copies refused in both orders. Ordinary aggregate ownership checks still forbid duplicate credited emitted owners.

closure_sweep.inputs: all original positive/zero-sized source relocations and all supplied personality definitions
closure_sweep.result: Existing foreign-reference and supplied-definition vetoes remain before aggregation; all v16 and inherited namespace/ABI/retention regressions executed. No name-only cross-unit witness or personality exception was introduced.

closure_sweep.inputs: unit source paths, compiled object and dependency paths/hashes
closure_sweep.result: V17 retains the source suffix in object paths; same-stem C/C++ units have independent compiler outputs. Dedicated regression executed.

closure_sweep.inputs: schema_version, record_kind, mode, result/fresh, whole-image/BLZ hashes/checks, covered fields, credited counts and units
closure_sweep.result: Positive full identity and hashes/checks are mandatory, covered fields forbidden. Missing/relabelled scope, missing units, empty credited-unit census and summaries refuse. No defaulting absent mode to full.

closure_sweep.inputs: selected model labels, catalogue/profiles/toolchain/exheader/matches hashes, harness and compiler digests; source/object/profile/compiler/flags/function rows
closure_sweep.result: Mandatory new-receipt fields cannot silently disappear. Unit sources/functions must be unique, credited function count agrees with unit rows, every used compiler has a digest, and source/object hashes exist. Empty compiler maps with used units and duplicate units refuse.

closure_sweep.inputs: explicit authorization count; removed_special_members, linker_section_rewrites, u1_witness_comparisons; fresh dependency manifest and headers
closure_sweep.result: All lists/counts, including zero-use unit lists, are mandatory; action/member records agree exactly. Each removed D0 has exactly one matching full-size retained D1 comparison with equal candidate/original hashes. Missing fields and wrong witness size refuse.

reporting_filter_sweep.behavior: Both bounded and full producers explicitly mark schema/kind/mode. Per-unit actions and exact witnesses retain original local ownership/indices and source/object/dependency/harness hashes. Bounded mode writes no hybrid image/BLZ payload or whole-image success flags.
New summaries preserve mode/covered and use record_kind build-summary; no units are invented, and neither new nor historical summary formatting can satisfy full receipt validation.
build_scope_valid is an unconditional PASS prerequisite for both complete receipts; new prepare records freeze build_evidence_version 2 and receipt hashes.
Consumers reload complete hash-bound receipts, compare their exact corresponding summary and frozen selection, and enforce positive full evidence. Finalize rejects a failed prepare before acceptance.

Diagnostic/review derivations preserve U1 owners, companions and actions, including zero-credit owners; they are not full receipts or independent authorization. Failed scope prevents prepare PASS even if a diagnostic summary can be formed.
Inherited explicit section-action/member reporting and complete comparison_inputs hash closure apply to v17; fresh MenuResetScene and refused MenuScene controls executed.
Inherited source/pair action/member/comparison_inputs propagation remains; model registry and all compiler-grid tests executed.
Every U1 model, including v17, is refused before candidate publication because the collector lacks per-comparison section-action receipts; all collector tests executed.
Consumes function-level rewrite metadata for erased call diagnostics; it does not produce U1/full-build authorization or credit. All argcheck tests executed.
Fixed armlink5-inline-branchnop-v2 context; no U1 selector, new permuter execution or U1 reporting claim.

historical_compatibility.models: v9-v16 algorithm selections remain available and unadopted. Only v17 enables closed_u1_composition/distinct build-unit object paths; common receipt producers now report positive schema/scope explicitly.
historical_compatibility.legacy_full_exception: Only explicitly requested historical verification of schema-1, no-mode/no-kind, non-v17 full evidence may use legacy formatting; positive whole-image/BLZ hashes/checks, fresh PASS, credited fields and units remain required. New prepare never enables this exception.
historical_compatibility.failed_postmortem: The pre-selector default-model legacy review path may register an exact FAIL/FAIL postmortem without claiming full success; finalize refuses its failed prepare. No covered evidence can yield accepted credit through this path.
